text:
incident-bot: Pager: elevated errors on /v1/generate (canary) - 5m error rate 8.5%, p95 latency 2.4s, spike started ~2090012320. Canary id=canary-2026-03-15-09. Auto-rollback attempted but reported stuck: draining timeout. @oncall please respond. :rotating_light:

alice: ack, I'm on it. grabbing logs and checking autoscaler and drain status.

bob: i'm the on-call for infra. looking at kubectl now, pods in canary set are terminating but some are stuck in Terminating state (finalizers). also seeing a lot of 500s from model runtime.

deploy-bot: Automated rollback triggered at 2090012338 -> status: IN_PROGRESS -> waiting on pod drain for node pool gpu-pool-3. timeout=300s.

carla: interesting — feature flag `new-compute-path` was toggled on for the canary rollout. are we sure there are no schema changes? any DB migrations?

alice: no DB migrations in this deploy. suspect runtime change + quantization path causing OOMs on a subset of GPUs. logs show repeated OOM and segfaults for model variant v2q8.

bob: i'm going to try a manual rollback since auto is stuck. proposal: flip flag off and manually rollback traffic to stable (v2). can someone confirm service account for redwoodctl has permission?

carla: confirmed. product-oncall, any customer-visible failure reports?

product-oncall: getting three separate alerts from large-tenant "AcmeCorp" complaining about 502s in their production usage. Estimated impacted requests ~12% over last 10m for that tenant. They flagged latency and content truncation.

alice: prioritize rollback. executing steps now.

alice: command run: ```
# force flag off and start manual rollback
redwoodctl feature-flag set new-compute-path false --scope=canary-2026-03-15-09
redwoodctl rollout undo --deployment canary-2026-03-15-09 --to-revision stable-v2 --force
```

deploy-bot: Received rollback command at 2090012354. Starting rollback orchestration. streaming logs: "drain requests -> redirect -> terminate pods -> verify stable replicas"

bob: seeing old stable pods come up on gpu-pool-1. scaling looks good. monitoring healthchecks.

alice: patching Nginx route to stop sending traffic to canary, command: `kubectl patch svc redwood-api -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"rollout":"stable-v2"}}}'` (dry-run first).

lucy: jumping in for verification steps — i'll run smoke tests against the stable endpoint and validate token billing path + streaming responses.

alice: logs: during rollback we did see a stale PV mount causing one pod to hang on termination. I forcibly removed finalizer and pod terminated. that cleared the drain.

bob: after pod termination fixed, rollback progressed to 80% and then to 100% at 2090012402.

lucy: smoke results: 10/10 generation requests succeed against stable-v2, p95 latency 450ms, embeddings OK. No 5xx observed in the next 2m.

product-oncall: I messaged AcmeCorp support, they report errors have dropped to baseline. Will monitor for 30m and escalate if anything else.

carla: customer impact estimate: high-tier tenant saw partial failures; we likely need to reach out for an incident communication. SRE note: cause appears to be model runtime regression when using quantized kernels on certain GPU drivers.

alice: post-rollback verification checklist: 
- confirm all canary pods terminated (done)
- confirm stable replicas >= expected (done)
- run end-to-end smoke suite (lucy done)
- monitor error rate and latency for 30m (ongoing)

deploy-bot: Rollback finished at 2090012402. Status: SUCCESS.

bob: i'm leaving a pinned snippet with the key logs referencing OOM and segfaults so research can pick it up.

alice: assigning postmortem to carla and ops lead. timeframe: 48h writeup + proposed mitigation (revert quant path, add additional canary gating, driver compatibility test).

carla: noted. i'll own the customer communication draft.

lucy: leaving oncall in 15m, handoff to bob for the remainder of the 30m observation window.

bob: ack handoff. will close thread if metrics remain stable after 30m.

incident-bot: Incident resolved (auto): error rate returned to baseline, p95 latency back to normal. Incident duration ~7m. Ticket created: INC-2026-0457.

alice: closing notes: avoid rolling the `v2q8` quantized variant to prod until we validate on gpu-pool-3 drivers. add a safety short-circuit in the rollout pipeline for finalizer/hanging pods detection. :white_check_mark:

carla: thanks everyone. good coordination. I'll kick off the postmortem doc and include timeline + customer comms.

product-oncall: AcmeCorp acknowledged the update and said they appreciate the quick rollback. they asked for a brief postmortem when ready.

bob: closing thread in 30m if no regressions.

alice: thx all.
